correctionToPreviousInference.statement: The first missing record proves only that record 0 was unwritten. Because the executable stopped before serializing the buffer, neither failed run establishes that every other record was unwritten.
correctionToPreviousInference.scientificImpact: No manifest, pull corpus, validation result, reciprocal selector, or coefficient output was uploaded from either run. The frozen numerical predictions therefore remain unobserved.

technicalChange.previousValue: write only when the flat triangle identifier equals the preregistered sample-side identifier
technicalChange.newValue: write the unique covering triangle at each preregistered safely interior sample
technicalChange.reason: Both triangles carry the same zero-left/delta-right x-ramp, so the reciprocal coefficient prediction is triangle-independent. The frozen sample points are more than 1024 signed area units from the preregistered diagonal, preventing a shared-edge write race. Triangle identity is unrelated to the selector and physical product hypotheses.
